Ose: Terminal UI

Box drawing, key reading, init/end, and draw operations (requires game feature for extended methods).

Use Case 1: Box Drawing

// boxes.ifa - Draw styled terminal boxes

Ose.bere();

Ose.apoti("Welcome to Ifa-Lang", 40);
Ose.ipinro("Features");
Ose.apoti("File I/O with Odi", 30);
Ose.apoti("Networking with Otura", 30);
Ose.apoti("Crypto with Irete", 30);
Ose.ipinro("Getting Started");
Ose.apoti("Run: ifa run file.ifa", 30);
Ose.apoti("Check: ifa check file.ifa", 30);

Ose.pari();

Use Case 2: Key Input Reader

// key_input.ifa - Read keyboard input

Ose.bere();
Irosu.fo("Press any key (q to quit)...");

ayanmo running = otito;
nigba (running) {
    ayanmo key = Ose.gbile();
    ti (key == "q") {
        ayanmo running = iro;
        Irosu.fo("Goodbye!");
    } bibẹkọ ti (key == " ") {
        Irosu.fo("Space pressed");
    } bibẹkọ {
        Irosu.fo("Key: " + key);
    }
}

Ose.pari();
